steps.name: train-yes
steps.probe: (g => { const c = g.SelectedChar; c.b[0x90] = 250; return (c => [String.fromCharCode(...c.b.slice(1, 1 + c.b[0])), c.b[0xAC] | c.b[0xAD] << 8 | c.b[0xAE] << 16, Array.from(c.b.slice(0x96, 0x9E)), c.b[0x90], c.b[0x32], c.b[0x11B]])(c); })((await import('/areas/ecl_host.js')).eclG)
